arena: [생존기] Touch of Karma absorbs all damage taken up to 50% of your max health for 10 sec and redirects 70% of it to the target. Use it when the enemy pops burst cooldowns and unloads on you.
[생존기] Diffuse Magic reduces magic damage taken by 60% for 6 sec and reflects harmful magic effects on you back to the caster. Use it when enemy casters' magic burst or magic DoTs pile up.
[생존기] With Turbo Fists, you parry all attacks while channeling Fists of Fury and slow enemies hit by 90%. When melee DPS are on you bursting, answer with Fists of Fury.
[제어] Grapple Weapon disarms an enemy's weapon and shield from 20 yds for 5 sec. Use it when weapon-wielding melee DPS pop their burst cooldowns.
[제어] Paralysis incapacitates the target for 1 min but damage can break it. Put it on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[제어] Leg Sweep stuns all enemies within 6 yds for 3 sec. Get on the enemy healer and have your team burst while they're locked down.
[차단] Spear Hand Strike interrupts a cast and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[해제] Tiger's Lust removes all roots and slows from an ally and makes them 70% faster for 6 sec, and Detox removes poisons and diseases. Free your rooted healer so they can break line of sight.
bg: [참고] With Ride the Wind, Flying Serpent Kick removes your slows and leaves a wind path where allies are 30% faster and immune to slows. Open a path in front of your flag carrier, or shake off chasers when you're carrying.
[위치] Fists of Fury with Turbo Fists slows all enemies hit by 90%. Channel it to hold the enemy flag or orb carrier.
[제어] Ring of Peace knocks back enemies entering the ring for 5 sec, but feared or disoriented targets can't be knocked back. Use it to push enemies not under your team's fears off the base flag.
[분담] Transcendence leaves your spirit behind for 15 min and lets you swap places with it. Leave the spirit at the base you're guarding and return instantly when it gets attacked.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Touch of Karma and Diffuse Magic right before the burst.
pvpTalents: Turbo Fists, picked by all top 47 Solo Shuffle players and all 43 Battleground Blitz players, parries all attacks while channeling Fists of Fury and slows enemies hit by 90%. Grapple Weapon, picked by 35 of 47 Solo Shuffle players, disarms an enemy's weapon and shield from 20 yds for 5 sec. Ride the Wind, picked by 33 of 47 Solo Shuffle players, adds slow removal and an ally speed-boosting wind path to Flying Serpent Kick.
